ND Iacob called his ſonnes, and ſaid to them : Come
together, that I (a) may, ſhew vou the things that ſhal
come to vou in the laſt dayes. 2. Come together, and
heare you ſonnes of Iacob, heare ye Ifrael your tather,
3.Ruben mv firſt-begotten, thou art my ſtrength, &
the beginning of my ſorow: former in guifts, greater in Empyre.
Thou art powred out as water, (b) encreaſe thou not :becauſe
thou diddeſt aſcend thy fathers bed, and diddeſt defile his couch.
5. Simeon and Leui brethren: veſſels of iniquitie Warring. 6. Into
their coumſel come not my ſoule, and in their congregation be not my
glorie: becauſe in their furie they ſlew a man, and in their wiltulnes
they vndermined a wal. 7. Curſed be their turie, becauſe it is ſtub.
borne : and their indignation, becauſe it is hard : I wil diuide them in
Iacob, and wil diſperſe them in Iſrael.
8. Iudas, thee thy brethren ſhal praiſe : thy hand ſhal be in the
nerk ot thyne enemies : thy tathers children ſhal adore thee. 9. A lions
whtlp Iudas: to the prey my ſonne thou didſt aſcend : taking thy reſt
thou didſt lye as a lion, and as it were a lioneſſe, who thal raiſe him vp?
in his life, fore-AWAY FROM IVDAS, ANDA DVREOVTSE
BESENT, ANDTHE SAME SHAL BETHE EX-
PECTATIONOF THE GENTILES. 11. Tying to the
vineyard his colt, and to the vine, o my ſoune, his ſhe aſſe. He ſhal
waſh his ſtole in wine, and in the bloud of the grape his cloke. 12. His
eyes are more beautitul then wine , and his teeth whiter then milke.
13. Zabulon ſhal dwel in the ſhore of the ſea, and in the toad ot
ſhips reaching as farre as Sidon.
Iſſachar a ſtrong aſſe lving at reſt between the borders. 15. He
ſaw reſt that it was good ; and the earth that is was very good : and he
put vnder his ſhoulder to cary, and became ſeruing vnder tributes.
16. Dan ſhal iudge his owne people, as alſo an other tribe in Iſracl
17. Be Dan a ſnake in the way, a ſerpent in the path, byting the
